coverage_explanation: Checks numeric temperature and humidity reporting in two sustained sensor states, display stability during released and sustained-press periods, and return to each sampled display mode after three presses. No numeric-distinctness assertion is made: unspecified light calibration may make light coincide with another displayed value. The available check schema cannot independently identify all three modes or group arbitrarily labeled, possibly multiline serial reports; therefore exact mode contents, complete three-field report grouping, and the two-second report cadence remain uncovered. Light calibration, anomaly thresholds, and warning wording are unspecified, so no invented light mapping or anomaly decision is required.
assumptions: D2 uses the disclosed bench default: a button to GND with INPUT_PULLUP, released HIGH and pressed LOW.
Three deliberate presses cycle through the three display selections and return to the same selection; no initial selection is prescribed.
Temperature and humidity are represented numerically in degrees Celsius and percent; labels and line layout are not prescribed.
Light calibration, low-light threshold, high-temperature threshold, and anomaly message wording are missing parameters.
The reference chooses raw ADC light, initial light selection, and illustrative thresholds light < 200 and temperature > 30 C. These choices are not candidate obligations.
Display equality checks use constant sensor states and allow at least 400 ms after button transitions. They do not require different modes to have different numeric values.
